meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 执行 Git 操作时,Claude 会先查看当前改动和近期提交风格,再把多个文件按目录和用途拆成几个独立提交(默认不会全塞进一个提交);也可用 rebase/squash 整理旧提交,并定位某行代码是谁、何时加入的。
howto.when: 任何 Git 操作都会触发;尤其当说到“commit”“rebase”“squash”等词,或询问谁写的、何时加入时,会切换到对应处理模式。

say.text: 帮我看看当前改动,按逻辑拆成几个独立提交。
say.note: 会先生成提交计划,再按依赖顺序逐个执行。

say.text: 把最近这几次提交 squash 成一个,信息写清楚。
say.note: 会用 rebase 自动整理并合并提交历史。

say.text: 这段代码是什么时候、被谁加入的?
say.note: 会通过 blame / log -S 定位引入它的提交。

howto.what_en: For Git operations, Claude checks repo state and commit style, splits file changes into logical commits instead of one big commit, rewrites history via rebase/squash, and traces who/when lines were added with blame/log -S.
howto.when_en: Triggered by any Git operation, especially when the user says “commit”, “rebase”, “squash”, or asks who wrote something or when it was added; Claude switches to the matching mode.

say_en.text: Review my current changes and split them into logical independent commits.
say_en.note: It creates separate commits in dependency order.

say_en.text: Squash the last several commits into one with a clear message.
say_en.note: It uses rebase to merge and rewrite the history.

say_en.text: Who added this line and when?
say_en.note: It uses git blame/log -S to find the introducing commit.
